note: Input for scripts/build-hero-outfits.py. One Sidekick preset per hero becomes a six-slot armor set; `set` prefixes the item ids and file names. Change `preset` to any of the pack's six (see .tmp-outfits/previews after --previews) and rebuild. `extras` add more items from the same pack (explicit part names, usually from other presets, rendered with that preset's palette); an extra whose id is `<set>-<slot>` fills an empty slot and becomes the default. Each collectible names the `realm` whose dungeons drop its pieces ('fortress', 'pass', 'bog', 'castle', 'forge' or 'raid' for the Pit; ARMOR_DROP_REALMS in src/shared/levels.ts says which map drops which). A collectible may name its own `pack`; the hero's own preset is the starter set and is always owned. Items carry `hero`, `set` and `realm` into the catalog. Each pack dresses one realm (`realm` on the hero and on every collectible); `starter` is the outfit every new hero wears, whatever the class.
